9.0.572.en: Smarter dual-layer updates (no duplicate energy/button spam), quieter Zigbee time polling on battery remotes, and 3-button scene remotes pairing on the correct driver.

9.0.573.en: Hardened multi-gang isolation and command pacing; quieter 0x0001 battery polls on remotes; cluster-aware forum/contributor dumps; power-restore rejoin detection.

9.0.574.en: Corrected pairing for several 2/3/4/6-gang wall switches that were landing on climate or the wrong gang count.

9.0.575.en: After a power cut, ZCL switches keep the Homey backlight and power-on settings instead of trusting the boot dump.

9.0.576.en: Stopped multi-gang switches from toggling the wrong relay after a re-pair; commands stay on their own endpoint and unused Tuya DP is not probed.

9.0.577.en: Multi-gang Tuya switches keep per-relay control after a power cut or re-pair, and silent Tuya MCU wall switches stay reachable.

9.0.578.en: Pairing no longer treats the Zigbee Green Power endpoint as an extra gang, so 2-gang switches and button remotes keep the right driver after a re-pair.

9.0.579.en: Scene/event mode is applied only on remotes that actually have it (TS004F). 3-button scene remotes keep per-endpoint presses, and wall switches keep their own switch type.

9.0.580.en: Mains switches fire a power-cut rejoin flow even after a short outage, 4-gang ZCL boards stay on the 4-gang driver, and 4-outlet strips no longer pair as a 2-button remote.

9.0.581.en: Improved battery percentage for wireless remotes (Zigbee, Tuya DP, and hybrid): real reports only, CR2032 curves, and no fake 50/100% while the cell is still unknown.

9.0.582.en: Mains devices keep last-seen across app restart, sleepy sensors skip Poll Control binds, and switch settings including inching are re-applied after a power cut. Metering plugs pair on the plug driver.

9.0.583.en: Wall dimmers keep the correct driver fingerprint, clamp brightness so the MCU does not reboot, and strip phantom battery after a wrong climate pairing. Sacred couples stay mfr+productId only.
